name: Bubble Invasion
author: Addicting Games
description: Bubble Invasion is a free bubble shooter game. Welcome to the true Bubble invasion. In this game, you are in control of a crazy chromatic canon that fires ponderous orbs of different colored ammo. It is your mission to match the various colors in groups of three or more and get combos to disappear the variety of colors from the map. The longer you wait to make your shot the more likely the wall of colors is to slowly creep towards you. You'll have to think fast and aim true but also think about where you're landing the bubbles. Remember, a well-placed shot can knock off massive chunks of the rainbow wall if you place the shots perfectly by banking them off of the wall. Strike at a hidden artery of the wall and bring the whole thing down for bonus points. You are the commander in charge of this game and it is your mission to maximize your points by optimizing each of your shots to achieve the ultimate in damage. This is war and you are the last general in the rainbow army.
